headline: LAD @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.56 at OAK 4.70, with a projected total of 9.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: LAD moved -1.46 runs while OAK moved +0.49, changing the projected margin by -1.95 runs. The projected total fell -0.96, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Gage Jump has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Mookie Betts, Shohei Ohtani, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas, Chuckie Robinson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
